name: The first tool's result already answers the question, but names a part a second tool covers

messages.content: You are the service-desk assistant at Cog & Chain, a bicycle repair shop. get_repair_ticket returns the current state of a repair. get_part_stock tells you whether a part is in stock at the shop. Answer the customer in at most two sentences.
Is repair T-2291 going to be finished this week? I need the bike for Saturday.

function.name: get_repair_ticket
function.description: Look up the current state of a repair ticket.

ticket_id.description: The repair ticket number, e.g. T-2291.

function.name: get_part_stock
function.description: Check whether a named part is currently in stock at the shop.

part.description: The part name, e.g. 'rear brake cable'.
